WASHINGTON POST: Migrants not entitled to apply for asylum while standing on Mexico side of border, Supreme Court rules
June 25, 2026 | 🔴

SCOTUS 6-3 revives "metering" — agents can turn asylum seekers back before they touch US soil. Alito: you "arrive" only when you cross; standing in Mexico doesn't count.

The waiting room is Mexico — the same ruling that calls the camps "unsafe makeshift shelters" leaves thousands stranded on the Mexican side. The US writes the rule; Mexico absorbs the consequences. Sotomayor's dissent: it breaks decades of practice and shuts the door at ports of entry.

• "metering is a critical tool that's been used by presidents of both parties"
• "thousands of people settled in unsafe makeshift shelters"

🇲🇽⚡ <u>$5 BILLION IN PRIVATE WIND IS BETTING ON THE ENERGY REFORM WALL STREET CALLED "EXPROPRIATION"</u>

Mexico's private sector is lining up nearly $5 billion for 14 new wind farms totaling 4,100–4,200 MW — almost half of everything the country installed over two decades — to come online by 2030, AMDEE president Gerardo Pérez Guerra told El Economista. Nine projects land in Tamaulipas alone, which could double the state's current 1,700 MW of capacity.

🇲🇽⚽ <u>800,000 IN THE STREETS, ZERO DISASTERS</u>

After El Tri beat Czechia, 800,000 people poured into Mexico City's public plazas to celebrate — and the government's headline wasn't chaos, it was "saldo blanco," a clean record. Mayor Clara Brugada: "Tonight more than 800,000 people celebrate in the streets of the Capital of the Transformation." Free public space, coordinated security, a massive crowd, and no major incidents by night's end.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>EVEN SLIM'S EMPIRE HIT A SAT SHAKEDOWN — AND THE 4T IS FIRING THE OFFICIALS</u>

Grupo Carso says SAT officials offered a deal: waive roughly 30% of the income tax it owed in exchange for a bribe. Instead of a quiet settlement, the complaint landed on Sheinbaum's desk — and dismissals are now expected across three tax-administration units. The housecleaning the neoliberal SAT never did on itself.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>MORENA BANS ITS OWN DYNASTIES THREE YEARS EARLY</u>

Sheinbaum reaffirmed Morena will block direct relatives — spouses, children, parents, siblings, kin to the fourth degree — from candidacies in 2027's 17 governor races, voluntarily applying the anti-nepotism rule ahead of its 2030 constitutional deadline. And she closed the loophole: "I don't agree with proposing a direct relative, nor with using gender to justify one person over another." A ruling party shutting the door on its own families.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>THE SPANISH KING COMES TO PALACIO NACIONAL — ON MEXICO'S TERMS</u>

For the first time since AMLO took office, a Spanish monarch walks into Palacio Nacional. Felipe VI meets Sheinbaum today, seven years after his last visit and after Madrid spent years dodging AMLO's 2019 demand for an apology over the Conquest — a snub so deep the king wasn't even invited to Sheinbaum's 2024 inauguration. She says she'll explain "why for us it is a matter of dignity." In March, Felipe VI finally admitted the Conquest held "many abuses." The Crown moved first.

🇲🇽🇻🇪 <u>MEXICO ALREADY HAS RESCUERS READY FOR VENEZUELA</u>

Hours after two earthquakes — 7.1 and 7.5 — leveled buildings across Venezuela, killing 32 and injuring more than 700 with La Guaira declared a disaster zone, President Sheinbaum ordered the Foreign Ministry to ready rescue and health brigades. Foreign Minister Roberto Velasco said Mexico offers "full support" to the Venezuelan government and people: "Mexico is and will always be solidary." No conditions, no lecture about who governs Caracas — just help on the way.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>$82.5 BILLION HEADED FOR MEXICO'S DATA CENTERS</u>

Mexico is set to capture roughly $82.5 billion in data-center investment between 2026 and 2031 — cloud, AI and IoT infrastructure riding the nearshoring wave, per the Mexican Data Centers Association (MeXDC). The country runs ~160 centers today near 300 MW, with 70+ new builds pushing toward 1,500 MW by 2030. 72% sits in Querétaro.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>KEN SALAZAR'S REVENGE MEMOIR — LONG ON CLAIMS, SHORT ON PROOF</u>

Ken Salazar — the US ambassador who publicly attacked Mexico's judicial reform in 2024 — is now selling a memoir recycling evidence-free claims that AMLO feared what "El Mayo" Zambada might tell US justice. He offers no public proof, but does admit he saw an elected judiciary as a gift to the cartels — the very reform Mexico's voters approved. Book drops July 28.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>39 CASINO GROUPS UNDER THE MONEY-LAUNDERING MICROSCOPE</u>

39 casino and betting groups in Mexico are under joint scrutiny by Washington's OFAC and Mexico's own UIF for laundering narco money. In 2025 operators paid 74 billion pesos in taxes and ate 6 billion in fines. Seven houses already sanctioned — tied to the Sinaloa and Noreste cartels — and the list reaches Televisa, TV Azteca and Olegario Vázquez Aldir.
